scope: FUTURE SAGA Chapter 4 Ultra Time Patrol Battle encounter evidence
verification_policy: Record encounter sequences from identifiable gameplay evidence without treating one run as proof of every possible variation. Separate observed sequence, reported variation, and unresolved encounter-pool questions.

sources.scope: Full Ultra Time Patrol Battles gameplay with timestamps for seven progression levels and named boss encounters.
Full Ultra Time Patrol Battles gameplay and artwork-reward segment; seven-stage progression is independently visible in the video description.
Official Chapter 4 product description; confirms one new high-difficulty Ultra Time Patrol Battles quest featuring numerous classic characters.

reconciled_structure.earlier_nine_battle_claim: A prior community report described three rounds of three battles, but the concrete gameplay evidence located here exposes seven numbered progression stages. The two descriptions are not merged until the relationship between 'rounds', 'stages', and individual encounters is established.
reconciled_structure.important_note: The seven-stage sequence is directly supported by the cited gameplay descriptions. It should not be converted into a claim that the mode contains exactly seven total battles without inspecting the full gameplay and branching behavior.

reward_observation.artwork_reward_segment: A gameplay source explicitly includes an artwork-reward segment after the seven-stage run.
reward_observation.super_rank_requirement: not established by this encounter evidence layer

important_nonclaims: A single observed run does not establish the complete encounter pool.
No stage is declared mandatory across all runs solely from one gameplay recording.
No enemy order is inferred for runs that may use alternate encounters.
The earlier nine-battle community description is retained as a separate lead rather than overwritten by the seven-stage gameplay evidence.
No artwork identity, item ID, drop rate, or exact reward condition is inferred from the presence of an artwork-reward segment.
research_targets: Inspect additional complete runs to determine whether stages 1-7 are fixed or selected from pools.
Determine whether the observed boss groups represent stages, rounds, or internal encounter bundles.
Reconcile the seven-stage gameplay evidence with the earlier three-round/nine-battle community report.
Map each stage to its boost-selection checkpoint and resource-reset behavior.
Identify the artwork shown in the reward segment and determine its exact acquisition rule.
